dedupe_keys.name: criteri localizzativi regionali degli impianti di recupero e smaltimento dei rifiuti

description: The Autonomous Region of Friuli Venezia Giulia, Waste Management and Contaminated Sites Service publishes geographic criteria for identifying suitable and unsuitable locations for waste-recovery and disposal facilities. The native catalogue contains 241 metadata representations covering 81 operation codes, including recycling, treatment, landfills, incineration and energy recovery. They describe the same regional siting-criteria programme, with operation-specific layers and downloadable Shapefiles or WMS/WFS access. Access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; the metadata date is 28 August 2024. These constraints can support waste-infrastructure location and capacity-planning simulations. They do not constitute an inventory of operating gas networks or prove that facilities have been built. Three previously grouped biogas entries are representations of one operation layer within this larger suite. Current legal applicability, spatial accuracy and suitability calculations were not independently verified. The related RNDT catalogue supplies the native metadata; no linked features or archives were retrieved.

notes: Adopted expansion of the existing three-entry BDAD group to the source-defined regional waste-facility siting suite. The same 241 native records contain 81 operation codes; common full descriptions, publisher, metadata date, rights and RIFIUTI workspace establish grouping. Preserve prior links and source receipts. Existing UUID/record identity is retained. Original gas classification and three-member scope are superseded by full native siting-criteria descriptions; historical links and record ID remain unchanged.
